summary: Use `pam_access` to allow the service account to log in only locally and from controller and execution nodes: add `+:ansible:LOCAL controller1.example.com ... en1.example.com` and `-:ansible:ALL` to `/etc/security/access.conf`, then run `sudo authselect enable-feature with-pamaccess`.
questions: How do I restrict the ansible user to log in only from AAP nodes?
pam_access access.conf example for service account
How do I enable pam_access with authselect?

answer_card.title: Allow logins only from AAP nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
```
# /etc/security/access.conf
+:ansible:LOCAL controller1.example.com controller2.example.com en1.example.com
-:ansible:ALL
```
```bash
sudo authselect enable-feature with-pamaccess
```
